rule: A gate may move to CLOSED only when every required evidence path exists and the closure criterion is machine-verifiable or explicitly documented as a bounded governance decision.

p0.name: 2026 electoral geometry
p0.resolved_claim: Working geometry is 92 local / 305 seats plus 12 regional / 90 seats, with 92/92 modern historical territorial continuity.
p0.remaining_gate: Authoritative row-by-row 2026 decree/table diff plus continued legal watch for superseding texts.
p0.closure_criterion: Machine artifact certifies all 92 local names/IDs/magnitudes and all 12 regional magnitudes against authoritative current-law source; zero unexplained differences.

p0.name: Exact 2026 legal votes-to-seats allocator
p0.resolved_claim: Fail-closed current-law allocator handles quotient, largest remainder, unique-list threshold and statutory tie rules and is mathematically equivalent on all 104 historical test vectors.
p0.closure_criterion: 92/92 local + 12/12 regional mathematical-vector equivalence; zero unresolved test-vector statutory ties.

p0.name: Registered-voter denominators
p0.resolved_claim: National 2026 N is fixed at 15,801,162; missing local N can be represented as a constrained latent vector with an empirical variance floor rather than fabricated point counts.
p0.remaining_gate: Fit constrained posterior over all 92 local N values and quantify seat sensitivity caused only by N uncertainty.
p0.closure_criterion: Every Monte Carlo N draw is positive integer and sums exactly to 15,801,162; posterior diagnostics pass; N-only seat-sensitivity is reported for all 92 local and 12 regional contests.

p0.name: Historical panel for uncertainty calibration
p0.resolved_claim: Canonical 2011/2016/2021 local panel contains 92/92 common constituency IDs, names and magnitudes; 2007 is auxiliary support and 2002 remains quarantined.
p0.closure_criterion: 2011, 2016 and 2021 raw files hashed and canonicalized; 92 common local IDs across all three; missing N remains missing rather than imputed.

p0.name: Optimal non-agentic structural baseline B*
p0.resolved_claim: Within the frozen preregistered model family, persistence-first is selected for vote composition and turnout on the 2016->2021 temporal validation.
p0.closure_criterion: Model family and hyperparameters frozen before validation; candidate scores and paired bootstrap reported; no post-validation search.

p0.name: Joint uncertainty and correlation model
p0.resolved_claim: Architecture is hierarchical national + regional + local innovations with separate turnout state; free 92x92 covariance is forbidden.
p0.remaining_gate: Post-selection parameter fit, calibration/coverage diagnostics and coherent election simulation certification.
p0.closure_criterion: Variance floors applied; posterior-predictive diagnostics published; no unjustified covariance degrees of freedom; >=50,000 coherent joint election simulations execute without invalid distributions.
